paperlab 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。Overleaf 式 LaTeX 论文工作台：在渲染后的 PDF 上选中任意文字批注，由 dsh agent 改写源文件、编译验证并提交 git 修订。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-5b51fe39ca207e21ea20.html
posts.en:
paperlab is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Overleaf-style LaTeX paper workbench: annotate any text in the rendered PDF and let a dsh agent revise the sources with compile checks and git history.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-5b51fe39ca207e21ea20.html
